name: Hao Tian International Construction Investment Group Limited
summary: Hao Tian International Construction Investment Group Limited, which began operating in 1962 and is headquartered in Wan Chai, Hong Kong, is a diversified investment holding firm and a subsidiary of Hao Tian Management (China) Limited. It leases heavy construction equipment such as crawler and mobile cranes in Hong Kong, Cambodia and Macau, sells construction materials and parts, and offers repair, transport and property development. It also provides financial services including asset management, brokerage and lending. It was formerly Clear Lift Holdings Limited.
